title: Chris Kelly's blues cornet and Broussard's trumpet imitation
summary: Broussard describes Chris Kelly's soft blues playing, accompanying him on piano, and how it inspired his own vocal imitation of a trumpet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: That's the trumpet player. He's the guy that was known for playing Kellis Love. That's the way I would tell him. He was one of the main elements at Jacob Melendez's party. Now, Chris Kelly was the guy. He could sit right here with that little short brass trumpet he had. Cornet. Cornet, yeah. That's what it... It wasn't... Looked like it was just about 12 inches long. And that guy would sit down as I blow this imitation. That's the way I got an idea of blowing this imitation of the trumpet. I tried to sound my notes, because he used to sound his notes so low. He could take that trumpet and sit in the corner of the room where he was, and he'd sound like he was a mile away. Yeah. And he could blow... He was strictly a blues player on a trumpet. He played CC Rider, Don't You Feel My Legs. And he played... What's this other... Blue Monday Blues. And he was strictly a blues... Kellis Love, that was his favorite number. He used to play that Kellis Love. And I played the piano behind him. And... Where, Howard, is he gone? Yeah. I wanted to make him get me a little wash down so I could have bowed that... This is the way he used to blow that trumpet. This is what he used to play. And I imitated. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ ¶¶ How could you love someone else, baby, and don't care for me? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . this imitation a little bit. At one time I could blow an imitation of a trumpet just as clear as any trumpet. That sounds good now. And it's in bad shape and right now I should have drank a drink of water or something like that, which I haven't drank water all day. I've been fooling around with these chords and with a wet mouth vocal and I can blow out a trumpet tune as clear as a trumpet. I'd blow all that, see like Levene Rose and all those numbers like that, Harry Jane's numbers, I'd blow that imitation of trumpet. That's what would make me uh raid so much along in the party, see.
